notes.title: What is That?! A Release Date for Passpartout 2 !??
notes.notes:
Bonjour my fellow artists!🍷🥖


It’s time to sharpen your pencils✏️ The day we’ve all been waiting for is coming super soon! This is as exciting as announcements get!




[b][h1]✨Passpartout 2 releases on Steam April 4🎨[/h1][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28422089/ca41a62cfeb20f23bc1fa6aa5804a94a09697112.png[/img]


At this very moment, we’re all smacking our keyboards as hard as we can - ironing out the final bugs to give you all as comfy and sweet an experience as we can. We’ve also finally decided on a price point. 
So, allow me to share some details about the release:


[b]🕰 It’ll release on Steam at 10 AM PST/6 PM GMT/7 PM CET
💶 Price  $24.99 / €24.99/ £20.99
👼 20% Sale discount for 1 week
🖥 Will officially support Windows and Mac[/b]



[previewyoutube=d-9rec1LU0Y;full][/previewyoutube]


As you can see in the announcement trailer there are quite a few new areas and characters you didn’t get a chance to meet in the demo last summer. We can’t wait until you get to try it!🏘


Please tell everyone to wishlist the game. Tell your friends, your grandma, your cat and even your car (smart cars can wishlist games now?)! Everything helps us continue making the games we love💕


Your support so far has been amazing and we’re infinitely grateful! You’ve helped us crack down on nasty bugs. You banded together and made Bull St. a sprawling business zone with a whopping 24 amazing ad posters! Thank you!


Allow me to take a moment as well to share the amazing posters made by you and the community. To be frank we were overwhelmed by how many great submissions we received!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28422089/6546ebc2fd94ae4de32ec19db7969593b8875b83.png[/img]


For those of you who missed it, if your poster was selected you’ll be notified by e-mail with info & a steam key around the time of release 📨


Now let's keep the hype up for release! And don’t forget to keep on drawing!


// Papa Mattias

notes.title: A Linux Update!
notes.notes:
Heya!

We were made aware of an issue on Linux systems where the mouse cursor would go invisible after finishing a painting. As this is less than ideal when you want to... you know... click on things, we're addressing that with this patch:

Changes:
- New dazzling cursor for the game to entice the Linux OS to switch back to it
- Fixed the painting brush cursor not correctly rendering in negative on Linux system

The new cursor has also been added for all other operating systems since we love all of you equally and don't want to play favorites.

Happy Painting!

notes.title: The Mac Update!
notes.notes:
For those who like keeping track, recently a PC update featuring stability improvements hit Steam with a promise of a Mac followup. After a bit of elbow grease, it's now ready for release!

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
- Updated the game engine, shoring up the occasional quirk the game might've had
- Got with the times and committed to 64-bit version. 32-bit versions will no longer be available.
- Replaced incompatible shaders with new ones. They were getting rusty anyways.
- Patched up any other graphical errors

This will ensure the game keeps running for you all in the foreseeable future on current devices. As for future devices running the new line of processor chips, that's a problem for future us to tackle.

Happy Painting!

notes.title: PC Update - Now works on all Laptops!
notes.notes:
Have you felt that tingling anticipation of starting Passpartout?

Opening up that configuration window and meticulously setting up the perfect resolution and nigh-redundant keybindings?

Eagerly pressing play with that yearning to paint on those minuscule canvases, only for it to trip itself up before the main menu shows, prompting the PC to shut down the game?

Are you one of many running an Intel Laptop not necessarily designed for gaming but capable of it? 

Then this update is for [b]you![/b]

With the help of some very patient people reaching out to our support, we've identified the issue to a graphical problem with Intel integrated graphics. 

As telling people to jam new hardware into their devices is pretty bad support practice, we've opted to update the game itself instead.

[b][h2]So what's the update?[/h2][/b]
It's a big one in a sense! 

To fix the problem we have updated the game engine (from the [i]ancient[/i] Unity 5.3.8 to 2019 LTS for those curious), so the game may prove more stable on other devices as well. 

This will show as an impressive amount of Megabytes to download, but functionally the game is still the very same it used to.

The most significant change you might notice is that the initial config screen is gone (no longer supported by the engine), so now you configure resolution and quality in the settings menu in-game instead.

Note also that this update is strictly for PC at the moment. Mac will get some attention soon enough. ;)

Happy Painting!

notes.title: Passpartout Halloween Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img=http://www.flamebaitgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/halloween-pic.png]


Watch the trailer here:
[url]https://youtu.be/VfWAQGAuldw[/url]
It’s the spooky time of year and for Passpartout that means eerie pumpkins, crooked trees, and spoopy ghosts. We have updated the game with the following features, most of which will be available until Novemeber 7th:
[list][*]Spoopified environments! All locations in the game have recieved their fair share of spook.
[*]Unlockable hats! Like getting dressed up? Now you can acquire all sorts of headwear!
[*]New customer! We figured ghosts are really scary so we added a bunch of them to the game! Might have been a mistake though… They are a little too chilling.
[*]Cloud saving!
[*]New scary music to go with everything else![/list]




*brzzzzttt*

…...


Lanterns sometimes appear really bright... I mean it’s not actually that strange, since that is their only purpose and all, but I just wanted to let you all know that I do actually find them incredibly ominous. One thing that is also worth saying, regarding bright things, is that I definitely don't fancy kind skeletons, like what's the point with a spoopy skellington if it’s nice to you? Stupid.

It’s time once again for a stew! What ingredients shall I use this year?? I’m considering some nutmeg! It does go quite well with human eyes…

That was odd sorry about that haha. I really need to focus my attention more properly in the future. Hugo is going to be furious! Oh no that’s not his name… Oh yes it’s Voidwalker, that was silly of me, excuse my manners!

Lately it’s been a little dark outside, I wonder what causes this behaviour. Although I actually like to use THIS ETERNAL VOID OF CHARCOAL BLACKNESS for my prasied and award-winning academic studies!

Forgive me, I usually don't go off track like this. Most times when I try to es... I mean, when I try to infiltrate video game source files! Most times when I do that, I can focus much and ... THE FINAL LETTERS ARE "E" AND "S" *brrttzz*

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 + SALE!
notes.notes:
[img=http://www.flamebaitgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/sale-mail-pic.png]

Today we are launching our second patch for Passpartout along with a 20% sale! The patch includes the following features:
[list][*][b]Landscape paintings[/b] - You can now flip your canvas 90 degrees and paint landscapes! Or other things, I guess.
[*][b]Endless mode[/b] – Want to relax and not have to worry about the state of your economy? In Endless mode you can paint without fear of going bankrupt!
[*][b]In-game feature of art contest winners[/b] – The winners of our weekly art contest #ArtofTheWeek will now be featured every week in the main menu of the game!
[*][b]Some scurvy secrets[/b] – yarr.
[*][b]Many smashed bugs[/b].

notes.title: Patch 1.1.12 – Haggle, Trading cards, and less bugs!
notes.notes:
Passpartout has been updated! We have introduced haggle as a feature, added cards you can trade, given the UI some love, and added the language of vikings and IKEA. More details below.
[list][*]Haggle: Now when you get a bid on a painting, besides from rejecting or accepting the bid, you can also choose to haggle it. If you’re lucky, you’ll get some extra cash, or you’ll end up with a customer not willing to pay as much.
[*]Steam Trading cards: Cards which can be traded with.
[*]Svenska: Also known as the Swedish language. You can now play Passpartout in Swedish.
[*]UI adjustments: Made some buttons glow sometimes.
[*]Bugfixes: Killed some bugs. No one likes bugs.[/list]
Again a huge thanks to everyone for playing, sharing art, and providing feedback in all forms, we appreciate you <3

notes.title: Passpartout BETA Now Closed - Release June 6th!
notes.notes:
The Passpartout BETA is now closed, but the game won't be inaccessible for long! We're working on the final improvements before the release on [b]June 6th[/b]. A [b]huge thanks[/b] to everyone who has participated in making Passpartout a better game. Your feedback has been invaluable!

Stay tuned for June 6th, we hope you're as excited as we are!

Cheers,
Team Flamebait
